line_items.reasoning: Q2 revenues came in at $21.7B (up 8% YoY), driven by record Markets and strong Banking/Wealth performance, putting full-year revenue tracking well ahead of the $83.1B–$84.1B guided range, which management subsequently raised.

EPS of $1.96 and ROTCE of 8.7% are solid but still below the 2026 ROTCE target of 10%–11%; no full-year EPS framework was broken, but the quarter's ROTCE remains below the long-term target, making this roughly in line with the intermediate trajectory guided.

Transformation expenses are increasing meaningfully in 2025 (vs. $3B in 2024) and elevated severance (~$600M forecast for full year) add pressure, but management has not indicated a breach of the slightly-below-$53.4B full-year expense guide, keeping this roughly on track.

Card NCL trends appear consistent with the guided seasonal H1 pickup / H2 improvement pattern, and NII ex-markets is tracking within the guided 2%–3% growth range despite the ACL build driven by idiosyncratic/transfer-risk items rather than broad credit deterioration.
